tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit. When void you must trump. Rank order is A>10>K>Q>J>9>8>7.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click a playable card to select it. A King + Queen of the same suit in your dealt hand score a marriage worth 20 points (40 if trump).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. Mariáš has no declarations — the only action is playing a card.
tutorial.info: Each round a rotating Soloist (★) plays alone against the 2 Defenders. Trump is the Soloist's longest suit, chosen automatically. Points: A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2 (120 total). Winning the final 10th trick scores +10. The Soloist wins the round if their side outscores the 2 Defenders; on a Soloist loss each Defender scores double. The first player to reach the target points (default 10) wins the match.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
